title: an ANSI export is read as Windows-1252
line: the harness tree written in Windows-1252, its header's CHAR ANSI, ingests the same 27 people with the registered mark, the trade mark and the en dash of its source titles as the file writes them, none replaced; the box-drawing characters of the header's tree note, which that character set cannot write, are the question marks an exporter for it writes

steps.say: the harness file as an exporter that writes ANSI would write it

expect.why: the same 27 people the file in UTF-8 gives
every text is the file's own, none replaced
